title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Growth
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, driven, and accomplished Senior Account Executive, Strategic Growth focused on executing an enterprise growth strategy in your designated APAC region in partnership with a global sales team devoted to our largest global client relationships in the Financial Services market. This is an opportunity to join a high-growth company and sell an award-winning product that is rapidly getting adopted across the market internationally, and this person will be able to make a significant contribution to the company’s growth and future success.

• Partner with the global sales team to build and execute a strategic client growth plan for your designated APAC region. • Deploy a long term account strategy, with short and medium term execution plans, layering a transactional sales motion with an enterprise mindset and focus. • An energetic and creative individual, possessing natural curiosity with the ability to learn quickly.

• Strong ability to develop rapport with new people, and to maintain relationships, combined with a positive, outgoing personality.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Security Foundations
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Anti-Abuse team within Security Foundations. This team is responsible for protecting Snowflake and our customers from abuse on the Snowflake platform - building foundational security primitives across a complex multi-cloud environment to combat fraud, account takeovers, data exfiltration, and AI security threats at the scale of Snowflake’s hyper-growth.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SECURITY FOUNDATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Design, build, and scale security-by-default capabilities that protect Snowflake products across a complex multi-cloud environment

- Develop intelligent security platforms and services that leverage AI/ML and risk scoring to identify, prioritize, and respond to security threats and policy violations

- Build real-time detection and prevention systems to defend against account compromise, AI abuse, and data exfiltration through adaptive enforcement and granular policy controls

- Create security intelligence and monitoring capabilities that detect suspicious account & user activity, generate actionable insights, and enable timely response

- Partner across Security, Engineering, and Product teams to define security strategy, influence product design, and drive adoption of secure engineering practices

- Raise the engineering bar by setting standards for system design, code quality, operational excellence, and scalable security architecture within the Security Foundations organization

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SECURITY FOUNDATIONS WILL HAVE:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

- 5+ years of experience in software development with one or more of the following: JavaScript, Java, Python, C, C++, or Go

- Proficiency in Python, SQL, or a similar language for building detections and data pipelines

- Experience designing, testing, and maintaining software solutions with a security focus

- A track record of leading projects independently and setting technical direction

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field

- Experience working with infrastructure across major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Hands-on experience with security primitives including static analysis, dynamic analysis, authentication and access management, DDoS mitigation, or security scanning

- Background in secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills for cross-functional partnerships

WHY JOIN OUR ANTI-ABUSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

The Anti-Abuse team sits at the intersection of security engineering and platform scale - you’ll be building foundational capabilities that protect millions of customers across every cloud, rather than maintaining legacy point solutions. You’ll have real influence over the roadmap and the opportunity to work on some of the hardest adversarial engineering challenges in the industry: fraud, account takeover, data exfiltration, and emerging AI security threats.

title: Product Lifecycle Management Analyst
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We're seeking a detail-driven Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Analyst to own the product data and change-control backbone behind Rivet's hardware programs.

You'll work across electrical, mechanical, optical, firmware, manufacturing, and quality teams to keep item data, BOMs, and engineering changes accurate and moving through the system without bottlenecks. You'll own the full product data lifecycle-from item and BOM structure through engineering change requests/orders, revision control, and release to manufacturing-so every team is building from the same accurate configuration.

The ideal candidate is meticulous, systems-minded, and energized by bringing order and traceability to fast-moving hardware development.

Responsibilities

- Own and maintain Bills of Materials across all hardware programs.

- Manage the engineering change process end-to-end (ECRs/ECOs)-routing, tracking approvals, and ensuring changes are implemented cleanly across BOM, drawings, and downstream systems.

- Administer configuration management for hardware programs, maintaining baseline configurations, revision history, and as-designed vs. as-built records from prototype through production.

- Serve as the primary owner of the PLM system (item master data, workflows, access, and data quality), and manage the PLM-to-ERP data flow to keep engineering and operations systems in sync.

- Maintain part and item master data integrity across PLM and ERP.

- Support document control-release, revision, and archival of drawings, specifications, and work instructions-ensuring the latest approved versions are always accessible to the teams that need them.

- Maintain traceability records (lot/serial genealogy, supplier certifications) to support quality, audit, and program compliance requirements.

- Partner with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain to ensure released data supports production readiness, and flag data or process gaps before they impact build schedules.

- Support new product introduction (NPI) programs by standing up PLM/ERP structures early and ensuring a clean data foundation as programs transition from development to production.

- Generate reports and metrics on change cycle time, data quality, and configuration status to give program and engineering leadership visibility into process health.

Requirements

- 6+ years in PLM, configuration management, or document control, ideally in hardware/defense.

- Hands-on PLM experience (Arena, Windchill, Teamcenter, or similar) and familiarity with PLM-ERP integration.

- Strong grasp of BOM structures (EBOM/MBOM), part numbering, and revision/effectivity management.

title: Business Development Director
description:
At Spiria , we design custom software solutions for organizations with real business challenges to solve through technology. Your role: finding those organizations.

You will open new accounts, understand the real issues behind an initial request, and guide clients toward an approach that creates value. You will not be selling licences or off-the-shelf solutions. Every engagement is different, and you will work with our technical experts to build strong, realistic and compelling proposals.

This is a true hunting role. You open doors, develop your first accounts, and help initial engagements take root and grow.

As a Business Development Director at Spiria , you will:

• Proactively develop your pipeline through targeted prospecting, networking, event participation and referral development.

• Qualify the real business needs behind an initial request and rule out opportunities that do not align with our expertise.

• Develop service proposals in collaboration with technical teams and take ownership of their final validation.

• Represent Spiria with stakeholders at both the executive and technical levels.

• Work closely with Marketing to build the sales funnel, without relying solely on inbound leads.

• Ensure a strong transition to Delivery and Account Management teams, while remaining involved in the growth of the accounts you develop.

What you will advise clients on:

• Custom software development engagements, from product strategy through to delivery.

• Organizations primarily active in manufacturing, defence, aerospace, financial services and insurance, healthtech, and technology, without being limited to these sectors.

• Complex engagements involving multiple stakeholders and consultative sales cycles lasting several months.

• Decision-makers such as VPs of IT, VPs of Product, CIOs, Directors of Digital Transformation, Directors of Engineering and business leaders.

• The support of a team of more than 150 specialists across Canada: architects, developers, UX designers, QA specialists, project managers and Marketing professionals.

• The ability to position AI as part of, or as an option within, our service offering.

Keys to your success:

• Demonstrated experience developing new accounts in technology professional services, custom software development, consulting or complex B2B solutions.

• A genuine hunter mindset: you know how to create conversations where there was no active demand to begin with.

• Strong consultative selling skills: long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, undefined budgets and tailored proposals.

• The judgment to speak about modernization, technical debt, architecture, risk or project scoping without needing to be a developer.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. French is an important asset in a pan-Canadian context.

• The autonomy and discipline to manage a territory, maintain a rigorous pipeline and bring in the right people at the right time.

• Thoughtful use of AI tools to improve your research, preparation, follow-ups and sales effectiveness.

• Resourcefulness and the ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.

• Willingness and availability to travel occasionally to meet with clients, as business needs require

Assets:

• An active network in financial services, insurance, manufacturing, defence or aerospace is an asset.

• Experience in a professional services firm.

• Knowledge of the Toronto market and its business and technology networks.

• Strong CRM discipline, particularly with HubSpot or Salesforce.

Employment details:

• Flexible work arrangements (remote, hybrid, or in-person), because what truly matters is not where you are, but what you do.

• Salary range starting at 100K, based on a workweek.

title: HRIS Analyst
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced HRIS Analyst to join Ramp's People team during an active Workday implementation. Reporting to our Senior HRIS Manager, you'll play a hands-on role in configuration and system support, partnering closely with our implementation partner and cross-functional teams through go-live and hypercare.

This is an opportunity to help strengthen the data integrity, controls, and employee experience that support Ramp as we scale. You'll bring a solutions-focused, collaborative approach and strong systems thinking to a fast-moving, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, understands how People data flows across systems, and looks for ways to streamline processes as they build them, staying flexible as priorities evolve along the way.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Support the configuration, testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance of Workday modules, including HCM, Benefits, Advanced Compensation, Time Tracking, and Absence

- Partner with key stakeholders across the business to gather requirements, run testing cycles, resolve issues, and ensure cutover readiness

- Run data validation and audits across HRIS and downstream systems, ensuring data integrity, security, and compliance through regular reporting

- Support system releases and enhancements, including testing changes, documenting outcomes, and triaging issues as they arise

- Train and enable team members and system users on existing and new processes and functionality

- Build and maintain SOPs and job aids that make recurring HRIS processes accurate, scalable, and easy for others to support

- Support AI transformation initiatives involving Workday, partnering with People, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to evaluate and implement AI-driven solutions

 

WHAT YOU NEED

- 3-5+ years of hands-on Workday experience, including configuration and production support

- Direct experience with one or more Workday modules: HCM, Benefits, Advanced Compensation, Time Tracking, or Absence

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to reconcile data, identify root causes, and troubleshoot discrepancies across systems.

- Strong attention to detail and track record of managing employee data with sound judgment, accuracy, and appropriate controls

- Ability to translate business requirements into configuration, testing, and documentation

- Proactive problem-solver who takes initiative to resolve issues with minimal oversight

- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner cross-functionally across People, Finance, IT and business stakeholders

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

 

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience supporting a Workday implementation post-production stabilization

- Familiarity with Workday reporting, integrations, or security concepts

- Exposure to automation tools or AI-assisted workflows

- Background in a high-growth tech or fintech environment, ideally with global scope

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES

En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, formation, et innovation ; affecté au Centre Microélectronique de Provence. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et intérêt pour la recherche appliquée.
Le département Systèmes et Architectures Sécurisés (SAS), du Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), étudie la sécurité des composants électroniques et des données qu’ils contiennent (tels que des clefs de cryptographie, des logiciels, des blocs de propriété intellectuelle, des données en mémoires, etc.) vis-à-vis de manipulations frauduleuses couramment appelées “attaques” matérielles. Les enseignants-chercheurs du département SAS contribuent au développement de protections matérielles, logicielles, et cryptographiques contre ces attaques, et plus largement à la proposition de solutions de sécurité pour les objets mobiles.
Le département SAS est associé au CEA Leti dans une équipe commune, l’EC SAS, comprenant actuellement 32 personnes.

Le recrutement d’un ingénieur de recherche en Sécurité Matérielle s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet SecMemPCM financé par la Région Sud. Votre mission est une mission de recherche sur le sujet de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles.

· Vous assurez un travail de recherche sur la susceptibilité des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles émergentes (eNVM) aux attaques matérielles, et plus particulièrement aux attaques par injection de fautes.
· Vous menez des essais expérimentaux de caractérisation du comportement de divers types de eNVM face aux attaques par injection de fautes. Vous analysez les résultats afin de comprendre et modéliser les mécanismes associés.
· Vous rendez compte des activités et des résultats qui relèvent des missions dont vous aurez la charge.
Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à conduire un travail de recherche sera essentielle pour réussir.

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Doctorat.

Vous avez des compétences scientifiques en Microélectronique et/ou en sécurité matérielle.

· Avec une expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité matérielle et des techniques d’injection de fautes.
· Junior accepté : Oui
· Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1).

Vos atouts supplémentaires :
• Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse en microélectronique et/ou sécurité matérielle.
• Vous possédez une expérience pratique des techniques d’injection de fautes.

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

title: Senior Design Engineer - MetaMask

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. As a Senior Design Engineer, you'll turn complex flows into simple and delightful experiences across our app and browser extension. Working closely with designers, engineers, and product managers, you'll take ideas from prototype to production - sweating the animations, haptics, and micro-interactions that make every interaction feel considered, not just functional. • Translate Figma designs into accessible, production-ready experiences with minimal handoff friction.

• Build agentic workflows and tooling that speed up design-to-code and day-to-day engineering work.

• Grow the MetaMask design system: reusable, accessible components built to scale across platforms.

• Move from idea to prototype fast and validate with real users.

• Push for craft everywhere - the small animation nobody asked for that makes an interaction click.

Key Experience

• Portfolio demonstrating delightful, polished interfaces and interactions - not just static screens, but the motion and detail that make them feel alive.

• Proven track record shipping high-traffic, consumer-facing products in React and React Native.

• Fluency in modern JS/TypeScript and cross-platform frontend architecture: performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns

• An eye for interaction design and motion - you know when animations and haptics earn their place and when they're just noise.

• Strong Figma literacy - you read a design file like code.

• Good judgment about when to polish and when to ship.

• Comfortable working autonomously across a distributed, global team

• Hands-on experience with crypto wallets, blockchain, or related Web3 products.

While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

title: Director, Financial Systems Engineering
description:
About Extend :

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend 's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:
Extend runs a service-contract business where every dollar must be traceable from inbound merchant data, through our operational and analytics databases, into the accounting system, and back out to obligor, reinsurer, and audit reporting. This role owns the systems and controls that keep that traceability automated, tested, and auditable as the business scales.
We are looking for a Director, Financial Systems Engineering to lead that work. The scope includes the invoicing logic, the financial data models the business reports from, and the automated controls that validate results before they reach an invoice. You’ll report into Engineering leadership, and you’ll lead a team of individual contributors.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will own SQL and dbt models in version control, review and approve changes to the logic that produces reported numbers, and answer for the correctness of what comes out. You will also own the cross-functional escalation path across Solutions Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Finance, Revenue/Go-to-Market, and Accounting when commercial commitments and system behavior need to be reconciled.
You will have wide latitude to shape how financial controls and revenue assurance work at a company growing quickly, including how much of that is handled in code.
What You’ll Do:

•
Own the reconciliation system across contracts sold, merchant invoicing, claims paid, and servicing reimbursements. Build automated tie-outs with alerting between inbound merchant data, operational databases, the analytics warehouse, the accounting system, and external reporting, so that variances surface quickly and are routed to an owner.

•
Own the invoicing logic and the programmatic controls that keep contracted commercial terms accurately reflected in it.

•
Own the financial data models the business reports from, including the logic that recognizes contract revenue as contracts mature and the record of what claims cost us. These live in the shared dbt repository and follow its platform standards for tests, PR review, and change control. You own the business logic in these models and review every change to it.

•
Partner with the merchant integration and Data Engineering teams on merchant configuration. They own ingestion and mapping. You facilitate internal audits of how inbound merchant formats map to internal representations, and work with them to resolve what those audits surface, so that expense and contract attribution holds up downstream.

•
Own the exception and reconciliation-break process , covering triage, resolution ownership, and root-cause tracking with SLAs on detection latency, so that findings inform systemic improvements.

•
Partner with Revenue/Go-to-Market on merchant escalations, including direct merchant engagement on billing questions, and coordinate across Solutions Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Finance, and Accounting on who needs to do what, when, and why

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure

description:
About the Role

As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer on the Compute & Storage Platform team in Toast, you will design, build, and operate the foundational distributed systems powering the Toast platform as the company expands into further international markets and broadens its product offerings to encompass retail shopping.

You will bridge the gap between core infrastructure and cutting-edge product development-building low-latency state and storage systems, scalable compute clusters, and high-throughput streaming pipelines. Your work will directly enable Toast product delivery across our Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).

Key Responsibilities

• Online Databases and Storage: Architect, deploy, and manage low-latency, highly available storage solutions (RDS Postgres and Aurora Postgres; DynamoDB; OpenSearch; S3) to power applications across the Toast product ecosystem.

• High Availability & Realtime Performance: Ensure sub-second end-user latency, near-zero-downtime reliability, and high throughput across storage engines to support Toast's products across POS, phone, computer, drive-thru, and kiosk interfaces.

• Infrastructure for AI-Driven PDLC: Automate infrastructure provisioning and compute pipelines.

• Cost Optimization & Performance Engineering: Right-size compute/storage resources, implement auto-scaling policies, and manage AWS infrastructure costs without compromising platform reliability or latency SLAs.

Required Qualifications

1. Core Infrastructure & Automation

• Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience building and managing scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

• Software Development: Fluency in Python , Go , or a similar language for infrastructure automation, tooling, or backend development.

2. Storage & Compute Operations

• Databases: Deep experience operating and tuning enterprise databases at scale. This should include at least one variety of relational database (such as Postgres, Oracle, or MySQL) and at least one type of nonrelational database (such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Opensearch).

• Containerization: Experience working with containerized environments and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes).

3. Systems Reliability & Observability

• Solid understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including monitoring, alerting, health checks, and performance troubleshooting in high-traffic environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

• Observability & Telemetry with Datadog, Prometheus

• AI/ML Infrastructure support

• Cloud Cost Optimization

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s commercial products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend microservices, guest- and restaurant-facing web apps, payment systems, event buses, and more. 

The Infrastructure Engineering group manages Toast's infrastructure via the AWS API, using configuration management tools like Terraform, Ansible, and internally developed clients using Python and Go. We rely heavily on Datadog and Splunk for monitoring and observability and on FireHydrant for alerting and incident response.

Infrastructure Engineering provides the products and services to support, deploy, and monitor our product suite, which uses a microservice architecture written using JVM and Node.js apps. AWS products are also in heavy usage, ranging from S3 to RDS, DynamoDB, ECS, Lambda, and many others. We have our own platform for user management, service discovery/elevations, and load balancing. We use Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data synchronization between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ and Apache Pulsar clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the applications' RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Build What Matters at RevStar

• Role Title: Data & AI Engineer (Databricks Specialist)

• Reports To: Data & AI Practice Lead

• Location: Remote (US-Based / Eastern or Central Time Zone Preferred)

• Employment Type: Contract

Ready to build greenfield Lakehouse solutions at the bleeding edge of AI and big data? RevStar is an innovation shop and official Databricks Partner launching a dedicated, cloud-agnostic Data, ML, and AI practice. Tired of spending months in endless corporate approval loops only to build AI concepts that never reach production? We turn modern Lakehouse architectures and production AI into live, scalable enterprise solutions in fast-paced execution cycles. We build fast, cut bureaucratic red tape, and ship production-ready solutions for client founders and tech leaders who value real engineering impact. In this role, you will work directly with data architects, scientists, and client leaders to turn complex data into scalable, production-ready AI models. • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.

• Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.

Automate data ingestion, storage, and feature engineering workflows to support downstream analytics and real-time AI workloads.

Collaborate directly with client tech leaders, product managers, and engineering teams to translate complex AI data requirements into clear business outcomes. Author clean technical documentation and lead seamless solution handoffs to client engineering teams upon project completion.
Requirements

• Core Experience: 3+ years in cloud-native data engineering with 2+ years of dedicated, hands-on Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow experience.

• Technical Mastery : High proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark frameworks, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or Databricks CLI).

• Strong Differentiator: Active Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate or Professional) or Databricks ML Professional certification is strongly preferred and will set your application apart.

• Consulting Mindset: Proven track record operating in fast-paced Agile/DevOps consulting environments, delivering cloud-agnostic architectures with exceptional client communication.

description:
OUR MISSION

We're not your average benefits platform; we're the unordinary force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology is the link that connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers

Our mission is clear: we're here to create a world where everything operates at its very best, ensuring that every employee receives the support they need to live life to the fullest, both at work and beyond.

YOUR MISSION

Ben has more business-critical bets than it has people who can own one. As our Chief of Staff, you will take the hardest and most ambiguous of them and turn them into shipped outcomes: new propositions, incubation bets, structural changes to how the company runs. When something matters and there's no obvious owner or playbook, it lands with you.

This is not your typical Chief of Staff role - it is a true builder's role. You'll run point on the cross-functional initiatives that decide where Ben goes next, in close partnership with the founders and with a real hand in shaping the company's next chapter. Ultimately, you’ll have huge agency to drive impact across the whole business.

One Honest Note

We won't pretend this is going to be easy. It's an intense role, and there'll be stretches that properly test you. But get it right, and it's the kind of experience that shapes a career - genuinely some of the most exciting, highest-impact work you'll ever do.

THINGS YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

- Own the grey space: take on our most ambiguous, highest-stakes cross-functional projects, the ones with no clear approach, and drive them from a blank page to a delivered result.

- Get our next big bets off the ground: new propositions, incubation, and the strategic projects that don't sit inside any one team's remit. You scope them, you build them, you deliver them.

- You'll own what used to take a team: use Claude, Cursor and similar tools to get through the research, the reporting and the busywork that used to need several people. AI tooling is already a big part of how this team works, and will be essential for this role. The bar is that you're already building with it.

- Win the room: write the narratives that go to the board, the all-hands and the wider company when a project needs buy-in or explaining.

- Build for scale: put in place the light-touch systems and workflows that let 90 people operate like 300, without adding process for its own sake.

YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE/ARE…

- Worked directly with founders: whether that came from strategy, consulting, banking, product, operations, or a Chief of Staff seat before. You know how to give a leadership team real headroom.

- Owned a problem from a blank page through to delivery: with no one else's roadmap to fall back on.

- Real range across strategy and execution: you'll build the model and write the board narrative, then go and do the unglamorous work that makes it happen.

- A background where "no" wasn't the end of it: you've got a plan over the line that other people had written off.

- A first-principles thinker: you work the answer out from scratch. Where you've inherited a playbook, you can tell us what you kept and what you binned.

- Known to follow-through until it's actually done: you chase, you follow up, and you don't let a stalled project quietly die.

- Scaled a fast-growing B2B SaaS business: not essential, but it will put you ahead. You know what breaks at each stage, and what to put in place before it does.

- Genuine hands-on AI experience: you use Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT and have experience building agents/ agentic workflows.

WHY JOIN US?

This is a chance to take on the largest, most complex problems in the business, owning them end to end, with the budget, the autonomy to make the calls, and a direct line to the Founders. You'll work across every part of Ben, which means you'll see how the whole company fits together in a way almost nobody else does. When something matters sign

Senior Software Engineer, Simple Trade Experience
We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Simple Trade Experience team within the Consumer & Business group. title: Internal Tools Developer
description:
The Product and Engineering Team is seeking a highly technical, service-oriented Internal Tools Developer to own and expand our internal infrastructure. You’ll work remotely (EST or Europe preferred) alongside Talent Acquisition, General Managers, and Product and Engineering teams to build and maintain critical systems-from custom Retool apps and Slack integrations to core service permissions and automation workflows.
About MarketerHire

MarketerHire ’s mission is to make expert marketing accessible to all.
Founded in 2019, we are growing rapidly and are a leader in the talent marketplace, on-demand staffing, and Future of Work categories. Our platform gives companies on-demand access to a global network of expert, pre-vetted marketing talent and is used by early-stage startups, billion-dollar unicorns, and Fortune 100 companies alike. Customers include Netflix, Palantir, Chanel, Allbirds, Lambda School, and thousands more.
We also contribute to the future of work, helping our marketers earn significant additional income while eliminating the hassle and risk of freelancing full-time. By default, all of our engagements are remote, enabling our talent to work anywhere in the world.
At MarketerHire , we’re passionate about building a diverse team. We care deeply about diversity, equality, and inclusion and strive to build a culture where everyone, from any background, feels included, supported, and free to be themselves. Diversity makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
If your experience is close to what we’re looking for, we want to hear from you. Experience comes in many forms - skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way.
Key Responsibilities

• Maintain and enhance our Retool apps and workflow ecosystem by writing JavaScript/TypeScript and SQL to implement new features, optimize existing modules, and refine UI/UX.

• Develop and troubleshoot Slack integrations using JavaScript and Slack’s API to automate messages, alerts, and workflows.

• Assist with the management of access controls and permission management across HubSpot, Retool, GSuite, Segment, and our proprietary systems-ensuring security best practices (principle of least privilege, API authentication, encrypted data handling).Collaborate with cross-functional teams to uphold internal service SLAs, prioritize incoming requests, and communicate status updates clearly.

• Work within a Git-based workflow: author pull requests, review code, and enforce best practices for version control and deployment.

• Participate in architecture discussions, recommend technology improvements, and proactively refactor code to reduce technical debt.

Required Qualifications

• Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and SQL-able to write complex queries, optimize performance, and troubleshoot edge-case failures.

• Hands-on experience with Retool (or similar internal-tools platforms), including custom component development and API integrations.

• Familiarity with Git workflows (feature branching, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD principles.

• Demonstrated knowledge of information-security fundamentals: managing API keys, enforcing the principle of least privilege, and securing data at rest and in transit.

• Track record of maintaining service-level commitments, communicating effectively with non-technical stakeholders, and translating business requirements into technical solutions.

• Proven experience building and maintaining Slack bots or integrations via the Slack API.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience; prior roles such as Support Engineer, Technical IT Admin, Customer Service Engineer, or Internal Tools Developer preferred.

Location & Schedule

• Full-time, 40 hours per week, remote.

• Preferred overlap with EST or European business hours to support U.S. and EMEA teams.

Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech

Willkommen bei vivenu - dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring - und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren.

Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.

Werde Teil unserer Mission - und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Warum bei vivenu einsteigen?

Live-Entertainment-Technologie
Spiele eine entscheidende Rolle für globale Marken und gestalte das Fan-Erlebnis neu - von Festivals bis hin zu großen Sport Events. Bei uns bist du Teil des Business of Fun - angetrieben von modernster Technologie, die besondere Momente für Millionen greifbar macht.

Nachhaltiges Wachstum
Wir wachsen nachhaltig auf einer profitablen, von Investoren unterstützten Basis mit echtem Product-Market-Fit. Das bedeutet kontinuierliche Investitionen in unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Produkte und unsere langfristige Vision.

Top-Tier Team
Arbeite mit über 160 engagierten Profis zusammen - darunter Führungskräfte von Google, Slack und Salesforce. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Live-Entertainment-Technologie - Entscheidung für Entscheidung.

Globale DNA
Wir sind ein vielfältiges, leistungsorientiertes Team mit sechs Standorten weltweit. Bei uns zählen Talent und Impact - nicht Hierarchie oder Hintergrund.

Rasantes Wachstum, in jeder Hinsicht
Sifted zählt uns regelmäßig zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Europa. Wir werden angetrieben durch konstantes Lernen, gemeinsame Erfolge und kollektives Wachstum.

Next-Gen-Führungskräfte & Insights
Arbeite Seite an Seite mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe in Tech - von Forbes 30 Under 30-Gründern bis hin zu „Executive of the Year“-Preisträgern. Bei vivenu setzt du neue Standards für die Zukunft der Ticketing-Branche.

vivenu Inklusions-Statement
Bei vivenu glauben wir, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden unseren Erfolg ausmachen - und dass wir mit mutigen, vielfältigen Menschen gewinnen. Die stärksten Teams entstehen durch unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Stimmen. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle befähigt fühlen, sich einzubringen, zu wachsen und zu gedeihen, um die Zukunft des Live-Entertainments weltweit mitzugestalten.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Group Reporting Team 👋

As a fast moving FTSE 250 business, we're looking for an experienced and technically excellent Head of Group Reporting to join us on a permanent basis. This is a senior role at the heart of our external reporting and financial control framework, calling for deep IFRS expertise and the confidence to navigate complex and judgemental accounting areas. It's a role that goes beyond a typical Group Reporting position, suited to someone who thrives in a varied, fast paced environment, is always ready to get involved, and loves learning new things. Our business changes daily, so we need someone who stays close to the operational side of things and can help us respond quickly and effectively.

Technical rigour is non-negotiable here. You'll be the go-to person for complex and judgemental accounting questions, expected to research positions thoroughly, form a clear view, and defend it with auditors and advisors, while translating that thinking into clear, accessible communication for senior non-financial stakeholders. You'll also bring commercial awareness, particularly around cashflow, liquidity and capital, along with the analytical instinct to spot when the numbers don't add up.

In this role as the Head of Group Reporting, you will...🚄

- Take ownership of producing the Group's IFRS annual and half yearly listed financial statements and annual report.

- Lead the year end and half year external audit and review processes end to end, keeping key stakeholders informed and preparing and presenting Audit Committee papers.

- Oversee the production and filing of subsidiary statutory accounts across our UK and international entities.

- Own the Group's cashflow forecasting process, providing insight and analysis on liquidity, capital allocation and capital structure to support CFO and Board decision making, working closely with treasury on execution.

- Act as the Group's primary technical accounting authority, researching and forming well reasoned positions on complex and judgemental areas, implementing new standards, and presenting conclusions to senior management, the Audit Committee, auditors and advisors.

- Take the lead on one off projects, partnering with teams across the business, while contributing to monthly reporting, annual budgeting, and ownership of specific balance sheet, cashflow and working capital areas.

- Build and support strong external relationships, including with auditors, loan providers and banking partners, and work closely with legal and CoSec to ensure reporting requirements are met on time.

- Lead Finance's contribution to the Group's material controls framework under Provision 29, maintain and develop the Group's accounting policies including for acquisitions and legal structure changes, and guide reporting systems and process change to protect the integrity of our control environment.
